svg.title: Two load paths from one bay
svg.desc: A schematic section of one megaframe bay. A building stands on sockets on the ground deck; its weight goes outward, drawn in teal, through the sockets and the 30 m underframe to the tension bands outside the liner, and each megaframe pier carries its load down through the ground into a root that spreads it onto the bands. In gold, the second path goes inward: from each pier crown a spoke runs toward the axis, the spokes merge in pairs, and they end on a hub ring around the spine. Either path holds the megaframe if the other is lost. Below the bands, across a gap, the stationary shell is drawn separately; it carries none of the city’s weight.
svg.text: Two load paths from one bay
A schematic megaframe bay, not to scale. Up the page is toward the axis.
Pier roots, spreading each pier’s load
Stationary shell: separate, it carries none of the city’s weight.
